# Python tools by Sambit Supriya Dash

> Three free, open-source Python tools that work offline: FuncLoom turns scripts and Jupyter notebooks into functions and packages, RefacTrail lints, formats and refactors, and FlowBlueprint draws architecture diagrams from code.

## FuncLoom (the functionizer)

Turn long scripts, snippets and Jupyter notebooks into verified functions and a modular package. Your original file is never changed.

- Website: https://samtherocket.github.io/funcloom/
- Source: https://github.com/SAMtheROCKET/funcloom
- Install: pip install funcloom
- Example: funcloom modularize nb.ipynb --output pkg

## RefacTrail (the refactorizer)

Find likely bugs, apply safe fixes, format code and check structure, naming, type hints and docstrings. Ruff-compatible rule codes.

- Website: https://samtherocket.github.io/refactrail/
- Source: https://github.com/SAMtheROCKET/refactrail
- Install: pip install refactrail
- Example: refactrail lint --fix

## FlowBlueprint (the architect)

Draw a script, notebook or whole project as an architecture diagram (draw.io, SVG, HTML or Mermaid) without running it.

- Website: https://samtherocket.github.io/flowblueprint/
- Source: https://github.com/SAMtheROCKET/flowblueprint
- Install: pip install flowblueprint
- Example: flowblueprint my_project/
